value.signature: fn open (& self , act : & pn_records :: ValidatedAct) -> Result < Vec < ActId > , pn_records :: commitments :: OpeningError >

review.body: { use pn_records :: commitments :: OpeningError as E ; let anchor = act . commitments () . ok_or (E :: Anchor) ? ; let supplied = self . 0 . iter () . find (| opening | & opening . act == act . id ()) . ok_or (E :: Target) ? ; dependencies_match_supplied_commitment (act . id () , & anchor . proposal , & anchor . dependency , & supplied . salt , & supplied . dependencies ,) . map_err (| e | match e { ProfileError :: Mismatch => E :: Mismatch , ProfileError :: Recipe => E :: Anchor , _ => E :: Representation , }) ? ; Ok (publish_opened_dependencies (& supplied . dependencies)) }
review.item_premise: The typed operation retains its public carrier or secret-container boundary; opening publication is explicit and never authenticates the retained anchor.
